_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'untilDate' shows it on every visit (once per browser session) until endDate, then it comes down on its own. Change 'id' for a NEW message. layout 'photos' is the photo-gallery feature card (art panel + 'logo' seal); leave layout out for the plain card. Other modes: 'once', 'acknowledge', 'always'.
title: 2026 UCC Winter Sportsmanship Summit
body: Relive the day! Photos from our Winter Sportsmanship Summit on November 11, 2026 are now online.
